description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 8 (BNG) and 13 (sustainable water management), together with partial discharge of Condition 12 (land contamination) of planning permission ref. 58841/APP/2026/547, dated 15-05-26 (Erection of 2no. dwellinghouses with associated landscaping, parking, cycle and bin storage, following the demolition of the existing bungalow.)
